title: Digital Atom Simula — Crisis communications simulator | Yuri Shubin
description: Simula, a crisis communications training simulator built by a digital products division Yuri Shubin helped create and lead.
ogTitle: Digital Atom Simula — Crisis communications simulator

text..simula-intro .work-lede: Simula helps communications teams rehearse difficult situations before they happen. It recreates media coverage, public reactions and team communication, giving people a chance to practice their response under pressure.
text..simula-contribution p: I helped create and led the internal digital products division that developed Simula. I grew the wider product team from 2 to 50 people and oversaw the development and operation of enterprise software used by tens of thousands of employees. Simula is one example of the products delivered by that team.
text..simula-capabilities article:nth-child(1: Rehearse communication with large audiences during a crisis.
text..simula-capabilities article:nth-child(2: Model news coverage and responses across communication channels.
text..simula-capabilities article:nth-child(3: Review how team members communicate and respond together.
text..simula-benefits li:nth-child(4) span: Designed to protect against unauthorized access.
text..simula-mobile-app p: Mobile version: role-based news scenarios, simulated reactions and feedback on messages.
text..simula-cta p: I work with entrepreneurs on new products and business lines, from testing opportunities to building teams and launching. Let's discuss what we could create together.
